changelog:
Initial release of Market Signals with comprehensive technical indicator scanning and scoring.

- Calculates 8 key technical indicators: RSI(14), MA(5/10/20), volume anomalies, ATR, MACD, Bollinger Bands (±2σ), VWAP, support/resistance levels.
- Generates an overall score (0–100) with buy/hold/watch/avoid suggestions.
- Supports multi-stock scanning (--scan), signal history tracking (--history), and support/resistance identification.
- Includes detailed per-stock analysis and ASCII chart visualization (--chart).
- Runs fully locally on CSV price data, with no network access required.
summary:
技术信号扫描器 v1.1.0。从价格数据计算RSI(14)、均线(5/10/20)、
成交量异动、ATR波动率、MACD、布林带(±2σ)、VWAP。
综合评分(0-100)给出买入/关注/观望/回避建议。
支持多股票一键扫描(scan)、信号历史追踪(history)、支撑/阻力位识别。

Use when: 需要快速扫描多只股票的技术面、
获取买入/卖出信号、信号历史分析、支撑阻力位参考。

🎉 v1.1.0 新增:
- 布林带(±2σ, %b, 带宽)
- VWAP 成交量加权均价
- 支撑/阻力位识别(基于20日局部极值)
- 信号组合综合评分(含明细)
- --scan: 多股票一
